The sibling artifacts are imported here only as source-qualified own-role evidence with exact provenance; r101 remains the predecessor lineage.

At the already-curvature-certified fixed rho0=0.55441744, strict monotonicity plus the directed sibling D endpoint intervals imply D(rho0) in [-0.04206253788253444, 0.03849563685667869]. Using rho*C_ell+(1-rho)*C_u=1 gives a deterministic corner ceiling M=1.02332020457273776587. Scaling the four-corner denominator by M makes all four corner directional expectations <=1; the already-directed coordinate-wise convexity in mu and log sigma then extends <=1 to the entire standardized Gaussian null rectangle. Thus q/(M p_rho0) is e-valid without an exact rho root or rho-interval curvature transport.

Therefore exact-root certification can recover at most about 0.02305 nat/block from this safe scaled construction and is no longer a safety prerequisite.
